complete_meaning: All 70 suggested milestone keys have a dossier with component statuses and a search note. complete does not mean every component file or every sibling band was retrieved.
limitations: Representative files only, except where a single table contains the whole set (PS1 table3, GROND ASCII, Hewett tables 2-6).
Unlabeled units were left unlabeled. FORS, F2 JH, FOCAS B, GTC OSIRIS Sloan g, Keck OSIRIS J, ERIS zip members and CFH12K catalog versus file units disagree or are unlabeled.
FORS and WFI SVO names were not mapped to ESO filter numbers.
HAWK-I K epoch files on disk were byte-identical, so both epochs were not compared.
J-PLUS full-efficiency numeric body and HiPERCAM hcam_g.txt and Gemini mktrans_zm_16_15.dat were truncated saves.
CDS FTP for J/MNRAS/379/1599 returned 404. The UKIDSS tar URL worked.
VISIR HTML login walls remain; two FTS text files were readable.
Las Cumbres zip returned 403 and the saved filter text was HTML.
NGTS, UFTI, DENIS, J-PAS, SCUSS, IPHAS, UVEX, INT/WFC, EFOSC and IMACS have no opened numeric curve.
Mosaic's large filter library, 90prime non-survey filters, CSP-II archive, DESI specter tables and WFCAM room-temperature scans were not opened.
SVO DetectorType was not used as the original counting convention.
Historical wavelength_unit and response_unit placeholders were replaced from each record's own evidence. Unlabeled files stayed unlabeled.
OmegaCAM with_ccd was downgraded to documented. Its numeric columns were not read.
The 2MASS QE row that says the table was not opened is historical. tbl11 is the file_verified QE row. The south atmosphere table is still unopened.
Search records were added for keys whose first write had a review and no sources.jsonl row. BOK/90prime points at the opened BASS g and r files only.
